_about: WS-DATA seed (brief §4.12, research §3.5, owner answers §0.6). 20 help questions (help: true) + 10 page-only questions used by upload, business, weddings and collection FAQ blocks. Answers are templates (CONTRACT.md Data §D2): no £, % or date literals. Edits via INTEGRATION.md only.

questions.q: How much does a custom sign cost?
questions.a: Text signs start from {price:from}. The designer prices your sign live as you type: size, number of letters, colours and backing all move it, and the price you see is the price you pay. Logos and artwork get a free mockup with an exact price within {value:mockupHours} hours.

questions.q: Do I see a drawing before you make it?
questions.a: Always. Within {value:mockupHours} hours of your order we send a proof drawing showing the exact words, lettering, colours and size. Nothing is made until you approve it, and tweaks to the drawing are free.

questions.q: What does it look like switched off?
questions.a: That depends on the jacket, the silicone sleeve around the LEDs. With a white jacket the tube looks white when it's off and glows your colour when it's on; a coloured jacket keeps its colour by day too. Colour-changing tubes are white when off. In the designer, tap 'Sign on/off' to see yours both ways.

questions.q: Can I send my logo or handwriting?
questions.a: Yes. Upload a logo, a sketch or a scan of handwriting and a designer redraws it as tube, then sends you a mockup and the price within {value:mockupHours} hours. Vector files (SVG or PDF) give the cleanest start, but a clear photo works too. Very fine detail sometimes needs simplifying, and we'll show you exactly how before anything is made.

questions.q: Can I have two colours?
questions.a: Yes. In the designer each line can have its own colour: warm white for 'Mr & Mrs' over a hot-pink surname, say. Each extra colour adds {rule:pricing.multicolourDelta|money}, and the preview, the drawing and your basket all show the colours line by line.

questions.q: What size should I go for?
questions.a: Measure the space and aim for a sign about half to three-quarters the width of the furniture beneath it: above a double bed, 80 to 100 cm reads well. Our sizes go by letter height, from Small to Statement, and the designer shows yours to scale in a real-looking room. Anything over 2 m we quote for you.

questions.q: What's in the box?
questions.a: Your sign on its acrylic backing, a power supply with a UK plug (never a travel adaptor) and a dimmer with a remote, included free. {fact:cableLengthM}

questions.q: Does it get hot, and is it safe?
questions.a: LED neon runs on a low-voltage supply and stays far cooler than glass neon, so it's happy on a bedroom wall. The power supply comes with a UK plug. {fact:psuMarking} {fact:wattsPerMetre}

questions.q: How long will it last?
questions.a: Every sign comes with a {value:warrantyYears}-year warranty on the LEDs, the power supply, the dimmer and the remote. {fact:ledLifetimeHours} Keep it indoors and give it a dust now and then.

questions.q: Can it go outside?
questions.a: Our standard signs are made for indoors. For a shopfront, a garden or a covered terrace, send us the details and a designer will quote an outdoor build within {value:mockupHours} hours. {fact:outdoorIndicativePct}

questions.q: Where are you based?
questions.a: {fact:workshopTown} Every sign is drawn, bent and mounted in our UK workshop, then sent out with free delivery across mainland GB.

questions.q: How long will it take?
questions.a: We send your proof drawing within {value:mockupHours} hours, and your sign arrives {fact:leadTimeDays} {fact:leadTimeFrom}. Weekends and UK bank holidays don't count, and if you approve by {rule:delivery.cutoffHour}:00 on a working day, that day counts. The designer and your basket show the dates for your postcode.

questions.q: Do you deliver everywhere in the UK?
questions.a: Delivery is free across mainland GB, and that includes the Highlands mainland and the Isle of Wight. We can't deliver to {exclusions} yet. Pop your postcode into the designer or the delivery page and it'll tell you straight away; if you're outside the area, ask us, because we're working on it.

questions.q: Do you do rush orders?
questions.a: Not at the moment. Every sign takes {fact:leadTimeDays} {fact:leadTimeFrom}, and we'd rather tell you that now than miss your date. Put your date into 'Need it by?' in the designer and it'll tell you whether standard making gets there; if it's tight, message us before you order and we'll be straight with you about what's possible.

variants.a: Yes, faster making is available. Put your date into 'Need it by?' in the designer and it shows the options and their prices for your date.

links.label: Check a date in the designer

questions.q: How do I hang it?
questions.a: You choose in the designer: wall screws with standoffs (the classic, for plaster or brick), hanging chains, adhesive strips (small, light signs on smooth walls, handy for renters) or a table stand for shelves and bars. It plugs into a normal socket, so there's no wiring to do. {fact:installMinutes}

questions.q: What if it arrives damaged?
questions.a: {fact:damageReportDays} Send us a photo of the sign and the box and we'll repair or remake it at no cost to you.

questions.q: Can I return a custom sign?
questions.a: Custom signs are made to your words, so they can't be returned for a change of mind once we start making them; the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 treat personalised goods differently. You can cancel free of charge any time before you approve your proof drawing. If anything is faulty we'll repair or remake it, and your statutory rights are not affected.

questions.q: Can I return a ready-made design?
questions.a: Yes. Ready-made designs come with a {value:readyMadeReturnsDays}-day change-of-mind return: tell us within {value:readyMadeReturnsDays} days of it arriving. {fact:returnPostage} If you changed the words in the designer, it counts as a custom sign.

questions.q: What does the warranty cover?
questions.a: {value:warrantyYears} years on the LEDs, the power supply, the dimmer and the remote, under normal indoor use. It doesn't cover accidental damage, or a standard indoor sign used outdoors. Your statutory rights are not affected.

questions.q: My sign won't light. What should I check?
questions.a: Work along the chain: is the socket switched on, is the power supply's cable pushed fully into the dimmer, and is the dimmer connected to the sign? Then try the remote with fresh batteries and turn the brightness up. Still dark? Send us a photo and we'll sort it under your warranty.

questions.q: Which files can I upload?
questions.a: PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF, up to 20 MB each. A clean, high-resolution file helps, but a clear phone photo of a sketch works too.

questions.q: What's the difference between vector and raster files?
questions.a: A vector file (an SVG or a PDF from a design program) is made of lines, so it scales to any size without going fuzzy: the cleanest start for a tube drawing. A raster file (PNG or JPG) is made of pixels; that's fine too, the designer simply redraws it by hand. Not sure which you've got? Send it anyway.

questions.q: Can you make a sign of a logo that isn't mine?
questions.a: We can only make logos and artwork you have the right to use: your own business logo, your own drawing, or something you have permission for. You'll tick a box to confirm this when you upload, and we may check with you before we make it.

questions.q: Do I get an invoice for my business?
questions.a: Every order comes with an invoice for your records.

questions.q: Can you help with installation?
questions.a: Our signs plug into a normal socket, so there's no wiring and no electrician needed. For a large sign or a tricky wall, a handyperson can fit it quickly, and our installation guide walks through each hanging method step by step.

questions.q: Do you do trade or event pricing?
questions.a: We don't run trade accounts, but for three or more signs (branches, venues, events or staff gifts) ask for a bulk quote. A designer replies within {value:mockupHours} hours with a proof for each design and one price for the lot, and staged delivery is possible.

questions.q: When should we order a wedding sign?
questions.a: About four weeks before the day. Your drawing arrives within {value:mockupHours} hours, making and delivery take {fact:leadTimeDays} {fact:leadTimeFrom}, and that leaves a week spare for nerves. Got a date in mind? 'Need it by?' in the designer checks it for you.

questions.q: What size works for a wedding?
questions.a: Roughly 60 to 80 cm for a table sign, 100 to 120 cm above the top table and 150 to 200 cm for a backdrop. Anything over 2 m we quote, and the designer shows every size to scale on a wedding backdrop.

questions.q: Can you put our names and date on it?
questions.a: Of course. You get up to three lines of 24 characters, so 'Mr & Mrs Patel' with your date underneath fits nicely. Type it into the designer and check the spelling: we make exactly what's on the drawing you approve.

questions.q: What happens to it after the wedding?
questions.a: It comes home with you. A wedding sign makes a lovely hallway or bedroom sign, and the dimmer takes it from dance floor to bedside. We don't hire signs out; every one is made for you to keep.
